description:
Pookie sleeps beside the lighthouse with her nose tucked beneath her tail. Reaching for her walking ribbon turns sleep into immediate excitement: for once Mother is not coming too. At the optional pier detour she becomes rigid and growls through the boards at something the child cannot see; hearing her name brings her attention back.

The walk makes returning together the meaningful action. It can finish without visiting the pier.

Her reaction suggests a sensed presence, not an ability to explain it. The first bark must not reveal Lapras.

Proposed return after evolution: as Mightyena, she still noses the walking ribbon before going outside, then stops when its old knot no longer sits comfortably. Refastening the ribbon is a small acknowledgment that she has grown. On the walk she pauses for the child to catch up; recalling her at the water remains a learned relationship, not proof that the species can identify ghosts. A familiar door and waiting companion can matter even on a visit without a quest.
